host_boundaries.source: Complete original Line data/getters/recache, Artist conversions and Axes relim under accepted short/default-style numeric Path storage host; original Artist stale/copy methods execute only in explicitly source-only rows.
host_boundaries.typed: Numeric/Category/Date LineData arrays, copied setter input, borrowed originals and per-generation Float64 TickValues. Public initial plot_line uses equal-length typed convenience, not the complete pyplot plot parser.
host_boundaries.initial_state: Source consumes initial Line stale and axis view requests explicitly. Whitebox fixture does the same without invoking a renderer/autoscale callback.
host_boundaries.path: No public Path object is introduced. Source row12 get_path error has the same either-invalid refresh stage as typed flat xy getter; cached source path values are retained, not falsely compared to a migrated Path API.
host_boundaries.detached: Original ownerNone fresh optional cache is projected to a controlled whitebox empty generation with invalid flags. Only refresh outcomes/raw data/invalid/stale are compared; no public unattached constructor or cache-absence identity claim.
host_boundaries.errors: Exact native errors retained; NumPy broadcast errors map unprefixed to InvalidTicks, detached float/date error messages use the existing NativeType prefix convention.
host_boundaries.source_only: Scalar rejected setter inputs, native ndarray original dtype, GUI stale callback targets and native Python copy.copy(Line) are outside this typed container/API profile.
host_boundaries.numeric: Finite/infinite bits are exact; NaN classification is asserted without payload promises. Native float-text bits, including NaN sign, remain in JSON and independently match Python float.
